context.stage: WF-03 Issue Resolving — SPT-01 onboarding schema provisioning gap (test design)

task.description:
Write test specs and integration test(s) for the ISS-0068 fix (SPT-01 onboarding schema provisioning wiring).

SPEC FILE: tests/specs/SPT-01-iss0068-onboarding-schema.md

Test cases required:

TC-SPT-01-ISS68-01: After executeSaga() completes for a new tenant, public.tenant_schemas contains exactly one row for that tenant's UUID, and information_schema.schemata contains the matching schema name.
  - Setup: provision a fresh test tenant via provisionTenantSchema() directly (or execute the full saga if the test harness permits; prefer direct provisionTenantSchema call for isolation).
  - Gate: verify tenant_schemas count > 0 for the tenant_id.
  - Teardown: clean up the tenant schema and registry row.

TC-SPT-01-ISS68-02: The retroactive migration (069/070) provisions schemas for tenants that pre-existed the fix — i.e. any tenant in public.tenant that had no row in public.tenant_schemas before migration was run. Since migration 069/070 has already run, verify that public.tenant_schemas count equals public.tenant count.
  - Setup: none (migration already applied).
  - Assert: SELECT count(*) FROM tenant_schemas = SELECT count(*) FROM tenant.
  - Assert: schema 'tenant_default' exists in information_schema.schemata.

TC-SPT-01-ISS68-03: provisionTenantSchema() is idempotent — calling it twice for the same tenant_id does not raise an error and results in exactly one row in tenant_schemas.

All test cases MUST:
- Connect to a real PostgreSQL DB via BPM_TEST_DB_URL
- Use per-test UUIDs (no hardcoded slugs)
- Clean up their own schemas and registry rows on completion (pass or fail)
- Never use error.SkipZigTest

Test source file: tests/integration/spt01_iss0068_onboarding_schema_test.zig

Set next_action: 'Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 4b)'
acceptance_criteria: All test cases connect to real PostgreSQL
All test cases clean up on both pass and fail
All tests added to build.zig test-integration step
